verdict.rationale: Bento documents some maintained first-party integrations: WordPress and WooCommerce packages (an ecommerce platform, related to the commerce part of the story), a ClickFunnels integration, a Supabase SDK, and an n8n surface. It also claims revenue attribution. None of the specific integrations the story names appear in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented Stripe integration, Shopify integration, Segment/CDP integration, a direct product-database sync connector, and independent corroboration that these integrations are maintained.
